Supplemental holds preserve APS300 and ERP linked-manual conflicts, PowMr voltage-mode ambiguity, all proposed Orion DC output-power rows, and MC4-specific tracker language unsupported for SmartSolar 150/70-Tr. Accepted/corrected rows preserve timed power, frequency tolerance, DC current-setting meaning, model-specific Growatt limits, temperature/cooling/firmware conditions, and separate ECO-WORTHY input thresholds. integrationReview.scope: Independent fixed-baseline specification integration, exact source row decision trace, immutable prior evidence, raw native capture, cumulative queue and repository scope review for Batch 35.
limitations: Capture consists of multiple native connector reads and is non-atomic; truncated product JSON is excluded rather than reconstructed.

This reviewer independently recomputed source-decision provenance and engineering mappings. Independent paired source reviewers reopened the supporting pages; this integration review does not claim a second complete live-web reopening of all citations.
Test, typecheck and build execution are recorded by the root validation artifact; this read-only verifier checks their retained artifact when supplied and does not rerun that suite.
The canonical review document embeds this report after verification and is excluded from input hashes to avoid self-reference.

engineeringReview.scope: Manually inspected all added technical field values, all newly added panel electrical ratings, runtime numeric projection changes, normalization transformations and unsupported/collision holds against the frozen approved source transcriptions and paired source decisions.

resolvedFindings.finding: The approved Format row explicitly supplied an L blade terminal, but the first normalization treated it as unsupported format while equivalent M8 terminal rows were accepted.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final normalization maps the unchanged value Industry reference Group 4D; L blade terminal to Connector. The final canonical evidence adds the matching connector field with the original exact-model datasheet citation.

engineeringChecks: Stäubli 60 A IEC connector current retains its up-to limitation, mated MC4-Evo 2, 10 mm² cable and temperature conditions. The 1000/1500 V alternatives retain their distinct mating types. BougeRV connector voltage and wire-size fit remain component-scoped, not assembly current/gauge.

All four Sun Xtender models retain every one-, two-, four-, eight-, 24- and 100-hour Ah value, common 25°C/77°F condition, 1.75 V/cell cutoff and after-15-BCI-cycle qualifier. Guarded import and runtime hydration preserve raw capacityAh anchors; the combined text is not projected into a scalar capacity.
